  SELECT * FROM demo_orders
  WHERE libra_id = ${libra_id}

  s.group_name AS group_name,
  s.is_control AS is_control,
  SUM(s.pay_amount) AS gmv,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(s.pay_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_order_value
  , __dimension_0.demo_segment AS demo_segment
FROM metric_source s

  CASE WHEN historical_spend >= 500 THEN '高消费力'

       ELSE '低消费力' END AS demo_segment
FROM demo_users) __dimension_0 ON s.user_id = __dimension_0.entity_id
GROUP BY s.group_id, s.group_name, s.is_control
, __dimension_0.demo_segment
ORDER BY s.is_control DESC
